note: Georgia state park on J. Strom Thurmond Reservoir.  Several RV campsites are right on the lakeshore with water views and direct lake access.  --AWH  GA DNR state park on a peninsula in Clarks Hill Lake (J. Strom Thurmond). Some campsites are seasonal. Also walk-in and backcountry tent sites, a tent cabin and 10 cottages. Boat launch in the campground, seasonal sand beach. --Claude
